title: The Scent of Change: Ambient Scents in VR Ice Cream Tasting
authors: S. Poggesi, J. Wagner, J. Hort
description: Investigating how congruent vs. incongruent ambient scents in digital immersive rooms alter sensory perception, product liking, and engagement.
description_it: Studio sull'impatto di profumi ambientali congruenti o incongruenti in ambienti digitali immersivi su percezione sensoriale, gradimento e coinvolgimento.

title: Where Will the Foodverse Take Us? A Cross-Cultural Study
authors: S. Poggesi, R. Linklater, J. Hort
